# 1QR Prime

> 1QR Prime (pronounced One QR Prime; also searched as 1 QR Prime and 1QRPrime) is an independent web platform for permanent business QR experiences, focused on restaurant and café digital menus, table ordering, payment handoff, staff workflows and customer pages in India.

Canonical website: https://1qrprime.com
Official brand spelling: 1QR Prime
Independent product: 1QR Prime is not affiliated with Google. Standard phone cameras, Google Lens and other QR scanners can open its public QR links.

## Product

- [About 1QR Prime](https://1qrprime.com/about): Official brand identity, product scope and naming.
- [Restaurant software](https://1qrprime.com/restaurant-software): QR-led restaurant operations, menus, orders, tables and staff access.
- [Restaurant QR](https://1qrprime.com/restaurant-qr): Permanent restaurant QR for menu, ordering and customer actions.
- [QR menu](https://1qrprime.com/qr-menu): Mobile browser menu that can change without reprinting the code.
- [Restaurant ordering system](https://1qrprime.com/restaurant-ordering-system): Table QR ordering and operational order states.
- [Pricing](https://1qrprime.com/pricing): Current product pricing and included capabilities.

## Markets and use cases

- [QR menu India](https://1qrprime.com/qr-menu-india): India-focused QR menu and UPI-aware workflow.
- [Restaurant software Bengaluru](https://1qrprime.com/restaurant-software-bangalore): Bengaluru-focused restaurant software page.
- [Café software](https://1qrprime.com/cafe-software): QR menus and ordering for cafés.
- [Hotel QR](https://1qrprime.com/hotel-qr): Guest menus and selected hotel information.
- [UPI restaurant ordering](https://1qrprime.com/upi-restaurant-ordering): Safe payment handoff concepts.

## Guides

- [QR Code Menu for Restaurants: The Complete Guide for 2026](https://1qrprime.com/blog/qr-code-menu-for-restaurants): A practical guide to digital menus, permanent QR codes, ordering workflows and the details that make the experience work for guests and staff.
- [How to Create a Digital Menu QR Code for Your Restaurant](https://1qrprime.com/blog/how-to-create-digital-menu-qr-code): A step-by-step walkthrough for creating a digital menu QR that guests can actually use.
- [QR Ordering for Restaurants: How It Works and When It Makes Sense](https://1qrprime.com/blog/qr-ordering-for-restaurants): Understand the guest flow, staff workflow and operational trade-offs before adding QR ordering.
- [Dynamic vs Static QR Codes for Restaurant Menus](https://1qrprime.com/blog/dynamic-vs-static-qr-menu): The difference is not the printed square. It is what you can safely change after printing.
- [UPI and QR Ordering: A Practical Guide for Restaurants in India](https://1qrprime.com/blog/upi-qr-ordering-restaurants-india): Design a safer UPI handoff that is clear about what the payment app confirms—and what it does not.
- [How Cafés Can Use QR Menus Without Ruining the Customer Experience](https://1qrprime.com/blog/qr-menu-for-cafes): A calm, fast QR menu can support a café without turning the counter into a technical support desk.
- [One QR, No Reprints: Why Restaurants Are Moving to Dynamic Menus](https://1qrprime.com/blog/dynamic-restaurant-menu-no-reprint): A permanent QR gives a restaurant room to improve the experience behind the printed code.
- [Restaurant QR Menu in India: A Practical 2026 Guide](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-qr-menu-india-guide): How Indian restaurants can choose, launch and operate a QR menu without turning the dining experience into a technical project.
- [Restaurant Software in India: What to Look for Before You Buy](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-software-india-buyers-guide): A buyer's guide to restaurant software covering QR menus, ordering, POS boundaries, staff workflows, payments and mobile usability.
- [Restaurant Ordering System: A Complete Guide to Table, Counter and QR Ordering](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-ordering-system-complete-guide): Understand the core components of a modern restaurant ordering system and how table QR ordering fits with staff-assisted service.
- [Digital Menu vs PDF Menu: Which Is Better for Restaurants?](https://1qrprime.com/blog/digital-menu-vs-pdf-menu): Compare responsive digital menus with PDF menus for mobile readability, updates, QR permanence, accessibility and restaurant operations.
- [Table Ordering System for Restaurants: How QR Table Ordering Works](https://1qrprime.com/blog/table-ordering-system-guide): A practical guide to table QR ordering, table context, order states and staff workflows for restaurants.
- [How Much Does a QR Menu Cost in India?](https://1qrprime.com/blog/qr-menu-cost-india): Understand the real cost of a restaurant QR menu in India, including software, printing, operations, payments and staff time.
- [How to Scan a Restaurant QR Code with Google Lens on Android](https://1qrprime.com/blog/scan-restaurant-qr-google-lens): Step-by-step guidance for opening a restaurant menu QR with Google Lens or the Android camera, plus troubleshooting tips.
- [Restaurant Software for Small Restaurants: What You Actually Need](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-software-small-restaurants): A practical software checklist for small restaurants that need simpler menus, orders and customer workflows without unnecessary complexity.
- [Café Ordering System: QR Menus, Seat Ordering and Counter Service](https://1qrprime.com/blog/cafe-ordering-system-guide): How cafés can combine QR ordering with counter service, live availability and a mobile menu without making the guest experience rigid.
- [Hotel QR Menu Guide: Guest Pages, Room Information and Dining](https://1qrprime.com/blog/hotel-qr-menu-guide): How hotels can use a permanent QR for guest menus and useful service information without creating a confusing mini-app.
- [QR Menu with UPI Payment: A Safer Restaurant Flow](https://1qrprime.com/blog/qr-menu-upi-payment-guide): How to connect a restaurant QR menu to UPI while keeping payee context, payment confirmation and merchant controls clear.
- [Dynamic QR Menu: The Complete Guide for Restaurants](https://1qrprime.com/blog/dynamic-qr-menu-complete-guide): What makes a QR menu dynamic, how permanent URLs work, and what restaurants should check before printing codes at scale.
- [Contactless Menu for Restaurants: What Still Matters in 2026](https://1qrprime.com/blog/contactless-menu-restaurants): Why restaurants still use contactless QR menus and what separates a useful digital menu from a low-quality scan experience.
- [Restaurant Menu Management Software: Features That Save Real Time](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-menu-management-software): A guide to menu management software covering availability, categories, prices, mobile edits and public QR synchronization.
- [Restaurant Order Management Software: States, Queues and Exceptions](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-order-management-software): How restaurant order management software should handle order states, table context, cancellation and slow orders.
- [Restaurant Table Management with QR Codes: A Practical Approach](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-table-management-qr): How table-specific QR codes can improve table context without turning a simple restaurant floor into a complicated system.
- [How QR Menus Affect Restaurant Customer Experience](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-customer-experience-qr): A practical look at speed, accessibility, choice, staff interaction and trust in restaurant QR experiences.
- [Restaurant QR Code Design and Placement: Tables, Menus and Counters](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-qr-code-design-placement): Practical guidance for restaurant QR code size, contrast, placement, testing and call-to-action text.
- [Restaurant Software in Bengaluru: A Guide for Cafés and Restaurants](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-software-bangalore-guide): What Bengaluru restaurants should evaluate when choosing QR menu, ordering and restaurant operations software.
- [How to Create a Restaurant Menu Online and Turn It into a QR](https://1qrprime.com/blog/create-restaurant-menu-online): A step-by-step process for creating a mobile restaurant menu online, testing it and publishing it behind a permanent QR code.
- [Digital Menu for Restaurants in India: Features and Best Practices](https://1qrprime.com/blog/digital-menu-restaurants-india): What Indian restaurants should include in a digital menu, from mobile performance and availability to UPI-aware actions.
- [Restaurant Payment QR vs Menu QR: Should They Be the Same Code?](https://1qrprime.com/blog/restaurant-payment-qr-vs-menu-qr): Understand the difference between a payment QR and a menu QR, and when one master restaurant QR should route to multiple customer actions.
- [One QR for a Restaurant: Menu, Ordering and Payments from One Entry Point](https://1qrprime.com/blog/one-qr-for-restaurant): How one permanent restaurant QR can route guests to menu, ordering, payment and other customer actions without reprinting.
